message: Include the TALK-BACK block and a valid PROMISE line before spawning a helper.
A finished helper cannot be resumed; start a fresh helper with a Delta.
Re-anchor the current request with the run goal, open items and owner rules.

A ledger tick counts only with APPROVE_CODE, or APPROVE_PLAN or SELECTED for Discovery items only from a helper verified as the reviewer agent (native subagent agent=reviewer, or a BB thread whose brief has an `agent: reviewer` line, pinned by its own command `printf '%s' '{"threadId":"<id>","agent":"reviewer","queued":false}' | bb plugin rpc call --input-file /dev/stdin opencode stampAgent` that printed {"ok": true}), or REPRODUCED or PASS from a verified qa helper for Discovery items only, plus a commit id and an existing evidence file.

Do not close the run or write the final report while counted ledger items are open or ticked without approval and receipt. Save ledger updates in a separate completed tool call before closing. To park an unproven HTML item, leave its checkbox unticked, add data-status="parked" to that item's input, and append a BLOCKED result with the reason and unlock condition (references/kickoff.md, Parking an item).
Two REVISE_CODE results on this slice mean split it or change angle; do not send a third fix brief.
